Class RmiServerProxy

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.it.network.client.RmiServerProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerProxy, RmiClient, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServerProxy extends UnicastRemoteObject implements ServerProxy, RmiClient
Client-side RMI Proxy.

Implements ServerProxy (transport-agnostic) and RmiClient (server → client callback).

After registration the server returns a per-player RmiPlayerSession; game actions are invoked as explicit remote methods on that session instead of being tunneled through a generic JSON method.
